ideas.idea: Prerender / and /guides as an alternative to removing ssr:false (routeRules)
ideas.why: Concrete, repo-specific nuxt.config change that makes content visible to non-JS crawlers.

ideas.idea: Scope the X-Robots-Tag middleware to /admin or delete it; note startsWith would catch future /guides/* pages
ideas.why: Accurate reading of headers.ts; the startsWith point flags a real future risk on nested guide pages.

ideas.idea: Replace button with NuxtLink and remove unused useRouter
ideas.why: Specific to index.vue and cleans up the unused router once the button is gone.

ideas.idea: Add per-page useSeoMeta titles/descriptions/OG tags to each page
ideas.why: Pages set no head of their own, so unique titles and descriptions are a concrete fix.

ideas.idea: Add canonical URLs, Open Graph/Twitter tags and set a site URL (e.g. @nuxtjs/seo)
ideas.why: No canonical or social tags exist and the site has a known base URL, so this is actionable.

ideas.idea: Add WebSite/Organization JSON-LD in app.vue and ItemList/Article schema on /guides
ideas.why: Structured data is valid but gives little benefit for a site with two near-empty pages.

ideas.idea: Resolve the /admin conflict: drop the robots.txt Disallow, serve noindex via header, or put admin behind auth
ideas.why: /admin noindex plus Disallow is a deliberate, correct choice, and this advice reverses it.

ideas.idea: Expand thin content: real route pages with one URL each, distances, difficulty, summaries
ideas.why: guides.vue and index.vue hold one heading and one sentence, so there is nothing substantive to find or cite.
Having no llms.txt is a deliberate choice that isn't a problem.

ideas.idea: State an explicit AI-crawler policy in robots.txt
ideas.why: The default is allow-all, so stating a policy changes almost nothing and applies to any site.

ideas.idea: Generate the sitemap (e.g. @nuxtjs/sitemap) with lastmod so it tracks real routes
ideas.why: A two-URL sitemap is already correct, so generation and lastmod add little.
Minor tooling note with no effect on discoverability, and it only matters if prerendering is used.
